summary: End-to-end testing of new Comparativa Semanal feature (planned vs real by week from Programa de Obra V2). Backend: 12/12 pytest passing. Frontend: 16 weekly cards render correctly, per-week filtering by fases activas verified (sem 0/1 only Excavación, sem 3 all 4 fases, sem 14 only Pilas), expand 'Ver N actividades' shows partidas detail, all weeks show 'Sin avance' / pendiente when no real metrics > 0 (bug fix confirmed). Regression: caras-excavación, presupuesto, avance-financiero, reporte-ejecutivo PDF still work. Zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/comparativa_semanal.py correctly distinguishes 'pendiente' from 'critico' by checking only real metric fields > 0 (excludes avance.id from truthy check) — bug fix verified.

services/cronograma_ai.py parse_excel_programa_obra correctly identifies 16 weekly column ranges starting at C13 (PRELIMINARES) and C21,C29,... (each spanning 7 day-columns). Returns expected ~16 active weeks for the V2 reference file.
Filter logic in ComparativaSemanalCards.jsx properly hides rows whose planned == 0 — verified visually for sem 0,1,3,14.
_id projection is excluded in all comparativa endpoints; no MongoDB ObjectId serialization issues.
RBAC verified: admin OK, non-assigned cliente returns 403, 404 for non-existent project.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_comparativa_semanal.py (NEW — 12 tests covering importar-cronograma V2 parsing, crear-desde-cronograma persistence, comparativa-semanal structure, estado=pendiente bug fix, RBAC, and regression of presupuesto/avance-financiero/reporte-ejecutivo)

success_rate.frontend: Pass — 16 cards render with correct fase filtering and activity expansion; 0 console errors

context_for_next_testing_agent: Comparativa Semanal endpoint = GET /api/proyectos/{id}/comparativa-semanal. To exercise the populated state in UI: (1) POST V2 Excel to /api/proyectos/importar-cronograma (file at /tmp/programa_v2.xlsx or download from https://customer-assets.emergentagent.com/job_b7325c2a-7c0a-429a-92d7-b149d6d868e4/artifacts/l5iabb24_Prados%20-%20Programa%20de%20obra%20V2.xlsx), then POST result to /api/proyectos/crear-desde-cronograma including programa_semanal and presupuesto fields. Frontend route /app loads dashboard; click a project card in 'Proyectos Activos'. Cards container data-testid='comparativa-semanal'; per-week data-testid='semana-card-{N}' and toggle 'semana-card-toggle-{N}'. Empty state data-testid='comparativa-no-programa'. Token in localStorage key is 'dron_token'. Reference parsed expectations: 16 weeks (S0..S15), sem 0/1 only Excavación, sem 12 stops pilas/anclas, sem 14-15 only Pilas (pilas de cimentación).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — feature works as specified. The previously reported bug (estado='critico' when no real avances) is fixed: comparativa now requires at least one real metric > 0 for tiene_avance=true; otherwise estado defaults to 'pendiente'. Confirmed via test_estado_pendiente_sin_avances and visual badge 'Sin avance' in all 16 cards of a fresh project.
